+   async getConversations(req: Request, res: Response) {
+     try {
+       const id = parseInt(req.params.id);
+       if (isNaN(id)) {
+         return res.status(400).json({
+           success: false,
+           message: '无效的项目ID'
+         });
+       }
+ 
+       const limit = parseInt(req.query.limit as string) || 50;
+       const offset = parseInt(req.query.offset as string) || 0;
+ 
+       const conversations = await ChatMessageService.getConversationsByProjectId(id, limit, offset);
+ 
+       res.json({
+         success: true,
+         data: conversations,
+         message: '获取项目对话记录成功'
+       });
+     } catch (error) {
+       console.error('Get project conversations error:', error);
+       res.status(500).json({
+         success: false,
+         message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '获取项目对话记录失败'
+       });
+     }
+   }

+ import api from './api';
+ import { ConversationRecord } from './chatHistoryService';
+ 
+ export interface ProjectConversationResponse {
+   success: boolean;
+   data: ConversationRecord[];
+   message: string;
+   error?: string;
+ }
+ 
+ /**
+  * 项目对话记录服务
+  */
+ export class ProjectConversationService {
+   /**
+    * 获取项目的对话记录列表
+    */
+   static async getProjectConversations(
+     projectId: number,
+     limit: number = 50,
+     offset: number = 0
+   ): Promise&lt;ConversationRecord[]&gt; {
+     try {
+       const params = new URLSearchParams();
+       params.append('limit', limit.toString());
+       params.append('offset', offset.toString());
+ 
+       const response = await api.get&lt;ProjectConversationResponse&gt;(
+         &#96;/projects/${projectId}/conversations?${params.toString()}&#96;
+       );
+ 
+       if (response.data.success &amp;&amp; response.data.data) {
+         return response.data.data;
+       }
+ 
+       return [];
+     } catch (error) {
+       console.error('获取项目对话记录失败:', error);
+       return [];
+     }
+   }
+ }
+ 
+ export default ProjectConversationService;
+ 
```

+       // 加载来源信息

+       const sources = sourcesResult.success &amp;&amp; sourcesResult.data ? sourcesResult.data : [];
+ 
+       // 分类来源信息

+       const internetInfo = sources.filter(s =&gt; s.type === 'url' || s.type === 'text');
+ 
+       // 加载技术点
+       const techPointsResponse = await api.get(&#96;/projects/${projectId}/details&#96;);
+       const techPoints = techPointsResponse.data?.success &amp;&amp; techPointsResponse.data?.data?.techPoints
+         ? techPointsResponse.data.data.techPoints
+         : [];
+ 
+       // 加载知识点
+       const knowledgePoints = techPointsResponse.data?.success &amp;&amp; techPointsResponse.data?.data?.knowledgePoints
+         ? techPointsResponse.data.data.knowledgePoints
+         : [];
+ 
+       setResources({

+         internetInfo,
+         techPoints,
+         knowledgePoints
+       });

+       setLoading(false);

+     } catch {

+ import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
+ import { MessageSquare, Clock, Bot, User, ChevronRight } from 'lucide-react';
+ import ProjectConversationService from '../../services/projectConversationService';
+ import { ConversationRecord } from '../../services/chatHistoryService';
+ 
+ interface ProjectConversationsListProps {
+   projectId: number;
+   onConversationClick?: (conversation: ConversationRecord) =&gt; void;
+ }
+ 
+ const ProjectConversationsList: React.FC&lt;ProjectConversationsListProps&gt; = ({
+   projectId,
+   onConversationClick
+ }) =&gt; {
+   const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
+   const [conversations, setConversations] = useState&lt;ConversationRecord[]&gt;([]);
+ 
+   useEffect(() =&gt; {
+     loadConversations();
+   }, [projectId]);
+ 
+   const loadConversations = async () =&gt; {
+     if (!projectId) return;
+ 
+     try {
+       setLoading(true);
+       const data = await ProjectConversationService.getProjectConversations(projectId, 50, 0);
+       setConversations(data);
+     } catch (error) {
+       console.error('加载项目对话记录失败:', error);
+     } finally {
+       setLoading(false);
+     }
+   };
+ 
+   const formatDate = (dateString?: string) =&gt; {
+     if (!dateString) return '';
+     try {
+       const date = new Date(dateString);
+       const now = new Date();
+       const diff = now.getTime() - date.getTime();
+       const days = Math.floor(diff / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
+ 
+       if (days === 0) {
+         return date.toLocaleTimeString('zh-CN', {
+           hour: '2-digit',
+           minute: '2-digit'
+         });
+       } else if (days === 1) {
+         return '昨天';
+       } else if (days &lt; 7) {
+         return &#96;${days}天前&#96;;
+       } else {
+         return date.toLocaleDateString('zh-CN', {
+           month: '2-digit',
+           day: '2-digit'
+         });
+       }
+     } catch {
+       return '';
+     }
+   };
+ 
+   const getAppTypeLabel = (appType: string) =&gt; {
+     const labels: Record&lt;string, string&gt; = {
+       'ai-search': 'AI问答',
+       'tech-package': '技术包装',
+       'tech-strategy': '技术策略',
+       'tech-article': '技术文章',
+       'brainstorm': '头脑风暴'
+     };
+     return labels[appType] || appType;
+   };
+ 
+   const getAppTypeColor = (appType: string) =&gt; {
+     const colors: Record&lt;string, string&gt; = {
+       'ai-search': 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-700',
+       'tech-package': 'bg-purple-100 text-purple-700',
+       'tech-strategy': 'bg-green-100 text-green-700',
+       'tech-article': 'bg-orange-100 text-orange-700',
+       'brainstorm': 'bg-pink-100 text-pink-700'
+     };
+     return colors[appType] || 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-700';
+   };
+ 
+   if (loading) {
+     return (
+       &lt;div className="flex items-center justify-center h-64"&gt;
+         &lt;div className="text-gray-500"&gt;加载中...&lt;/div&gt;
+       &lt;/div&gt;
+     );
+   }
+ 
+   return (
+     &lt;div className="h-full flex flex-col"&gt;
+       &lt;div className="mb-4 pb-4 border-b border-gray-200"&gt;
+         &lt;h2 className="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900"&gt;对话记录&lt;/h2&gt;
+         &lt;p className="text-sm text-gray-500 mt-1"&gt;共 {conversations.length} 条对话&lt;/p&gt;
+       &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+       &lt;div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto space-y-2"&gt;
+         {conversations.length === 0 ? (
+           &lt;div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center h-64 text-gray-400"&gt;
+             &lt;MessageSquare className="w-12 h-12 mb-4 opacity-50" /&gt;
+             &lt;p className="text-sm"&gt;暂无对话记录&lt;/p&gt;
+           &lt;/div&gt;
+         ) : (
+           conversations.map((conversation) =&gt; (
+             &lt;div
+               key={conversation.conversation_id}
+               onClick={() =&gt; onConversationClick?.(conversation)}
+               className="p-4 bg-white rounded-lg border border-gray-200 hover:border-blue-300 hover:shadow-md transition-all cursor-pointer group"
+             &gt;
+               &lt;div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3"&gt;
+                 &lt;div className="flex-1 min-w-0"&gt;
+                   &lt;div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2"&gt;
+                     &lt;MessageSquare className="w-4 h-4 text-gray-400 flex-shrink-0" /&gt;
+                     &lt;h3 className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-900 truncate"&gt;
+                       {conversation.session_name || '未命名对话'}
+                     &lt;/h3&gt;
+                   &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+                   &lt;div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2"&gt;
+                     &lt;span
+                       className={&#96;text-xs px-2 py-0.5 rounded ${getAppTypeColor(conversation.app_type)}&#96;}
+                     &gt;
+                       {getAppTypeLabel(conversation.app_type)}
+                     &lt;/span&gt;
+                     {conversation.status &amp;&amp; conversation.status !== 'active' &amp;&amp; (
+                       &lt;span className="text-xs px-2 py-0.5 bg-gray-100 text-gray-600 rounded"&gt;
+                         {conversation.status === 'archived' ? '已归档' : '已删除'}
+                       &lt;/span&gt;
+                     )}
+                   &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+                   &lt;div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-gray-500"&gt;
+                     &lt;Clock className="w-3 h-3" /&gt;
+                     &lt;span&gt;{formatDate(conversation.updated_at || conversation.created_at)}&lt;/span&gt;
+                   &lt;/div&gt;
+                 &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+                 &lt;ChevronRight className="w-5 h-5 text-gray-400 group-hover:text-blue-600 transition-colors flex-shrink-0" /&gt;
+               &lt;/div&gt;
+             &lt;/div&gt;
+           ))
+         )}
+       &lt;/div&gt;
+     &lt;/div&gt;
+   );
+ };
+ 
+ export default ProjectConversationsList;
+ 
```

@@ -1,1 +1,290 @@

+ import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
+ import { ChevronDown, ChevronRight, FileText, Globe, Brain, Package, MessageSquare, Check } from 'lucide-react';
+ import { Project } from '../../types/project';
+ import { SourceInformation } from '../../services/sourceService';
+ import { TechPoint } from '../../types/techPoint';
+ import { KnowledgePoint } from '../../types/knowledgePoint';
+ import { ConversationRecord } from '../../services/chatHistoryService';
+ import sourceService from '../../services/sourceService';
+ import ProjectConversationService from '../../services/projectConversationService';
+ import api from '../../services/api';
+ 
+ interface ProjectSidebarProps {
+   project: Project;
+   onSelectTechPoint?: (techPoint: TechPoint) =&gt; void;
+   onSelectResource?: (resource: SourceInformation) =&gt; void;
+   onSelectConversation?: (conversation: ConversationRecord) =&gt; void;
+ }
+ 
+ const ProjectSidebar: React.FC&lt;ProjectSidebarProps&gt; = ({
+   project,
+   onSelectTechPoint,
+   onSelectResource,
+   onSelectConversation
+ }) =&gt; {
+   const [expandedSections, setExpandedSections] = useState&lt;Record&lt;string, boolean&gt;&gt;({
+     resources: true,
+     conversations: true
+   });
+   const [resources, setResources] = useState&lt;{
+     files: SourceInformation[];
+     internetInfo: SourceInformation[];
+     techPoints: TechPoint[];
+     knowledgePoints: KnowledgePoint[];
+   }&gt;({
+     files: [],
+     internetInfo: [],
+     techPoints: [],
+     knowledgePoints: []
+   });
+   const [conversations, setConversations] = useState&lt;ConversationRecord[]&gt;([]);
+   const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
+ 
+   useEffect(() =&gt; {
+     loadData();
+   }, [project.id]);
+ 
+   const loadData = async () =&gt; {
+     try {
+       setLoading(true);
+ 
+       // 加载资源
+       const sourcesResult = await sourceService.loadSourceInformationByProjectId(project.id);
+       const sources = sourcesResult.success &amp;&amp; sourcesResult.data ? sourcesResult.data : [];
+       const files = sources.filter(s =&gt; s.type === 'file');
+       const internetInfo = sources.filter(s =&gt; s.type === 'url' || s.type === 'text');
+ 
+       // 加载技术点和知识点
+       const detailsResponse = await api.get(&#96;/projects/${project.id}/details&#96;);
+       const techPoints = detailsResponse.data?.success &amp;&amp; detailsResponse.data?.data?.techPoints
+         ? detailsResponse.data.data.techPoints
+         : [];
+       const knowledgePoints = detailsResponse.data?.success &amp;&amp; detailsResponse.data?.data?.knowledgePoints

+ import React from 'react';

+ import { SourceInformation } from '../../services/sourceService';
+ 
+ interface ResourceDetailPanelProps {
+   resource: SourceInformation | any;
+   onClose?: () =&gt; void;
+ }
+ 
+ const ResourceDetailPanel: React.FC&lt;ResourceDetailPanelProps&gt; = ({
+   resource,
+   onClose
+ }) =&gt; {
+   const formatDate = (dateString?: string) =&gt; {
+     if (!dateString) return '';
+     try {
+       const date = new Date(dateString);
+       return date.toLocaleString('zh-CN');
+     } catch {
+       return '';
+     }
+   };
+ 
+   const getIcon = () =&gt; {
+     if (resource.type === 'file') return &lt;FileText className="w-5 h-5 text-blue-600" /&gt;;
+     if (resource.type === 'url' || resource.type === 'text') return &lt;Globe className="w-5 h-5 text-green-600" /&gt;;
+     return &lt;Brain className="w-5 h-5 text-orange-600" /&gt;;
+   };
+ 
+   const getTitle = () =&gt; {
+     if (resource.type === 'file') return '文件详情';
+     if (resource.type === 'url' || resource.type === 'text') return '网络信息详情';
+     return '知识点详情';
+   };
+ 
+   return (
+     &lt;div className="h-full flex flex-col bg-white"&gt;
+       {/* 头部 */}
+       &lt;div className="px-6 py-4 border-b border-gray-200 flex items-center justify-between"&gt;
+         &lt;div className="flex items-center gap-3"&gt;
+           {getIcon()}
+           &lt;h2 className="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900"&gt;{getTitle()}&lt;/h2&gt;
+         &lt;/div&gt;
+         {onClose &amp;&amp; (
+           &lt;button
+             onClick={onClose}
+             className="p-2 text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-100 rounded-lg transition-colors"
+           &gt;
+             &lt;X className="w-5 h-5" /&gt;
+           &lt;/button&gt;
+         )}
+       &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+       {/* 内容区域 */}
+       &lt;div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-6"&gt;
+         &lt;div className="max-w-3xl space-y-6"&gt;
+           {/* 标题 */}
+           &lt;div&gt;
+             &lt;label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-2"&gt;标题&lt;/label&gt;
+             &lt;div className="text-base text-gray-900"&gt;{resource.title || '未命名'}&lt;/div&gt;
+           &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+           {/* URL（如果有） */}
+           {resource.url &amp;&amp; (
+             &lt;div&gt;
+               &lt;label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-2"&gt;链接&lt;/label&gt;
+               &lt;a
+                 href={resource.url}
+                 target="_blank"
+                 rel="noopener noreferrer"
+                 className="text-blue-600 hover:underline break-all"
+               &gt;
+                 {resource.url}
+               &lt;/a&gt;
+             &lt;/div&gt;
+           )}
+ 
+           {/* 描述/内容 */}
+           &lt;div&gt;
+             &lt;label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-2"&gt;
+               {resource.content ? '内容' : '描述'}
+             &lt;/label&gt;
+             &lt;div className="text-sm text-gray-700 whitespace-pre-wrap"&gt;
+               {resource.description || resource.content || '暂无描述'}
+             &lt;/div&gt;
+           &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+           {/* 类型 */}
+           &lt;div&gt;
+             &lt;label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-2"&gt;类型&lt;/label&gt;
+             &lt;div className="text-sm text-gray-700"&gt;{resource.type}&lt;/div&gt;
+           &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+           {/* 创建时间 */}
+           {resource.created_at &amp;&amp; (
+             &lt;div&gt;

+       setLoading(false);

+

+           &gt;

+           &lt;/button&gt;
+         )}
+       &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+       {/* 内容区域 */}
+       &lt;div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-6"&gt;
+         {loading ? (

已完成页面重构，主要变更如下：

## 完成的工作

### 1. **左侧边栏组件** (`ProjectSidebar.tsx`)
   - 项目详情标题
   - 已关联技术信息（可折叠）：
     - 已选择技术点
     - 已上传文件
     - 已选择知识点
     - 互联网信息
   - AI共创信息（可折叠）：
     - 对话记录列表

### 2. **右侧动态内容面板**
   - **技术点详情面板** (`TechPointDetailPanel.tsx`)：显示技术点信息，支持编辑（名称、描述、类型、优先级、状态）
   - **资源详情面板** (`ResourceDetailPanel.tsx`)：显示文件、网络信息、知识点等资源的详细信息
   - **对话详情面板** (`ConversationDetailPanel.tsx`)：显示对话的完整消息历史

### 3. **主页面重构** (`ProjectManagementPage.tsx`)
   - 改为左右分栏布局
   - 左侧固定宽度（320px）显示项目侧边栏
   - 右侧动态显示选中项的内容
   - 未选择时显示提示信息

### 4. **交互逻辑**
   - 点击左侧的技术点、资源或对话，右侧显示对应详情
   - 技术点支持编辑模式
   - 所有面板支持关闭操作

页面布局与功能已按需求实现。左侧展示项目信息和资源分类，右侧根据选择动态显示对应的详情内容。

- **中间**：四个功能入口按钮（AI内容问答、技术策略、技术包装、技术通稿）
- **右侧**：用户按钮（带下拉菜单）
